breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between using a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh and making it gamma-centered. The ground truth resolves this by removing the 'gamma-centered' instruction. The agent, however, repeated both contradictory requirements in the generated specification: 'Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift and gamma-centered alignment.'
